# Jetty Metrics

> An OSGi component that instruments Apache Karaf's embedded Jetty server with Dropwizard Metrics, capturing request rates, response times, and status code distributions.

Key facts:
- Java 21, Maven multi-module project (2 modules)
- OSGi Declarative Services with maven-bundle-plugin for bundle packaging
- Dropwizard Metrics 3.2.6 (metrics-jetty9) for HTTP handler instrumentation
- Apache Sling Commons Metrics 1.2.6 for MetricRegistry integration
- Jetty 9.4.x (provided by Apache Karaf 4.4.7)
- Karaf feature packaging for one-step deployment
- License: Apache 2.0

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): Project overview, architecture diagrams, build and deployment instructions
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Developer guide with build commands, module details, and coding conventions
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Development setup, issue reporting, and pull request guidelines

## Modules

- [jetty-metrics-impl/pom.xml](jetty-metrics-impl/pom.xml): OSGi bundle containing JettyConfigurator — the component that wraps Jetty's handler with Dropwizard's InstrumentedHandler
- [jetty-metrics-karaf-features/src/main/feature/feature.xml](jetty-metrics-karaf-features/src/main/feature/feature.xml): Karaf feature descriptor bundling metrics-core, metrics-jetty9, sling-commons-metrics, and the impl bundle
